svg.text: Every airborne electrical part, with the four motor power branches shown separately.
One ESC per motor. Motor phase wires never
VIN from PDB BAT+; GND from PDB BAT-
VOUT = +5 V rail; GND = common GND
Vbat -> PDB BAT+ 5V -> +5 V G -> GND
Volt / Curr -> STM32 ADC inputs, see sheet 2.
Each listed GND returns to the same common ground.
* Confirm the core-board 5 V input, 3.3 V output and regulator current headroom. SD-card write bursts must
not brown out the controller. If insufficient, add a suitable separate 3.3 V regulator.
Do not join the ESC BEC outputs or PDB BEC outputs to the Waveshare +5 V rail. Never feed raw battery voltage into the STM32 or sensors.
Rev A | 17 October 2026 | Functional wiring plan. STM32 header positions and firmware mapping remain unverified.
